title: Explicit R5 external batch validation v2 (selected runtime v3)
$comment: Semantic validation recaptures the exact required adapter set, command templates, helper hashes and complete descriptor/content inventories. Schema alone never authorizes launch. The process180 budget is the execution deadline, including full pre/post validation and RPC reads. Physical kill/reap/socket/owner cleanup is mandatory before qualification and can require a cleanup tail; OS uninterruptible waits have no hard physical-return bound. Accepted per-case cancellation before finalization invalidates the entire staged batch. A lease-held outer barrier covers initial preflight, setup, execution and postflight. Physical cleanup uses independent kill/wait reaping, never a retry of the pipe-drain routine. Unknown cleanup retains blocking ownership and cannot release the lease or publish qualification. V2 requires explicit selected3 and authenticates the runtime manifest serialized bytes through its independently supplied pin; the pinned outer contract delegates that existing authority and admitted bundle. Canonical runtime_sha256 remains equality evidence only. Omission remains batch-v1/runtime-v2.
